a college apartment that reflects you

Laid-back beach vibes meet modern luxury at ICON. Located in the heart of Isla Vista – a short walk or pedal from UC Santa Barbara and Campus Point Beach – our close-to-campus student housing sets you up for an unforgettable college experience. Here, you can effortlessly balance your studies, hobbies, and social life with unmatched, beautiful surroundings.

Live the college life you envision at ICON. Our community amenities have been reimagined and redesigned to level-up your lifestyle. Endless areas to relax and socialize, to study and thrive, and to hit your goals.

Amenities

ICON has it all: A rooftop deck with stunning views of the Santa Barbara Channel. Endless areas to relax and socialize, including a grilling area, yoga zone, and a sundeck. Two fitness centers that let you take your workout indoors or out. And multiple study lounges for group work or independent study.
